The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors in the statistics section.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError because cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected numeric values. This indicates that the formulas injected into the 'Task' worksheet use undefined names, missing functions, or incorrect syntax. While the 'net metric' assertions passed, the 'statistics' matrix mismatches suggest a failure in calculating derived statistical rows.
